items.title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
items.summary: Officials have so far managed to avoid a repeat of last weekend's rioting and looting as hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations.

items.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
items.summary: The slowed Starlink connections had affected the Ukraine's military and drone operations for a week.

items.title: Palestinian families displaced as Israeli forces demolish Hebron homes
items.summary: The crackdown follows the killing of two Israeli soldiers by two Palestinian gunmen on Friday - and comes just days ahead of Israel's election.

items.title: Man arrested after fire at Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
items.summary: Some 200 emergency personnel were deployed to fight the blaze at the Nazi dictator's Alpine residence in Germany.

items.title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
items.summary: Kaylub Giamanco has been hailed as a hero for killing a teenager who fatally shot three children and a teacher.

items.title: British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas
items.summary: Nathan Gregory says the loss of childhood sweetheart Leanne "is unimaginable for our family".
